READ-ONLY AUDIT. Do not edit, create, commit or delete any file in treams-rs; do not run builds or tests. Read files only.

Repository: treams-rs (treams-rs: Rust core + Python package python/treams_rs mirroring upstream treams conventions; MkDocs site under docs/, nav in mkdocs.yml).

Binding references: plan.md §4 "Glossary" and §5 "Naming rules"; the "Writing style" section of decisions.md (banned words in user-facing text: contract, gate, harness, lane, campaign, canonical, semantics, surface (API), boundary (interface), leverage, utilize, facilitate, orchestrate, ergonomic, first-class, plus 'bridge(s)' for adapters per the glossary 'framework adapters (never bridge/engine)'; no meta commentary such as 'this page explains', no history wording 'previously/now/new/formerly'; define technical terms at first use).

YOUR SLICE, two parts: A) Hand-written docs pages (exclude generated files: docs/reference/python/** and any '<!-- generated: ... -->' ... '<!-- end generated -->' regions) and README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md: jargon, meta commentary, history wording; glossary disagreements (e.g. 'origins' for expansion centres, 'outgoing' for singular, 'polarization=' used for the plane-wave state where it must be pol=, old Python names such as SphericalWaveBasis/TMatrixC/MultipoleWave/coeffs.*_with_context/lattice.expansion/diff.cluster/diff.wigner/kind= selectors, old module paths _core.py/_adapters.py/_physics.py/_source.py/_plane.py/config.py/support.py/generate_agent_docs.py, stale statements like 'one implementation in _framework.py'); stale Rust paths that no longer exist in crates/treams-core/src (verify with ls/grep). Known items to verify: docs/design/adapters.md, docs/development/architecture.md 'Framework bridges' row, docs/differentiation/frameworks.md (:44 'moving origins', :118, :233 'currently requires kz=0'), docs/guide/api-discovery.md:26, README.md:74, docs/reference/glossary.md Rust column, docs/development/documentation.md 'To add an example' (assumes every example has a treams file). B) Duplicated logic across python/treams_rs/_framework.py, _framework_backend.py, _framework_waves.py, _framework_tmatrix.py, _framework_smatrix.py, advect.py, jax.py, torch.py that a later package could fold (repeated helper bodies, repeated validation, parallel per-framework functions with identical bodies, repeated module docstring boilerplate). For each: locations, what is duplicated (line counts), and a one-line folding proposal.

Owner map (first match wins):

  • docs/coming-from-treams/**, docs/reference/glossary.md -> D10
  • README.md, docs/index.md, docs/getting-started/, docs/guide/ -> D08
  • docs/differentiation/** -> D09
  • docs/design/** -> none (D15 is done; say 'none (docs/design, D15 merged)')
  • docs/development/**, CONTRIBUTING.md, scripts/README.md -> D18 if it is doc-path/history wording, else none
  • python/treams_rs/{advect,jax,torch,testing,_records}.py, python/treams_rs/_framework*.py -> P32 (docstrings only; code folding there is 'none — needs a new package')
  • other python files: P25 {special,coeffs,misc,sw,cw,pw}, P27 lattice, P28 {ebcm,io,iterative,operators,_operators,_operator_objects,_array,_bases,_lattice,_material,_validation,_polarization,_modes}, P30 {_tmatrix,_smatrix,_waves,_cluster,_periodic,_results,_upstream,init,diff}

Return a concise Markdown section with two parts: "## Docs pages against the glossary and writing style" (table | File:line | Text (short quote) | Problem | Fix | Owner |, at most ~50 verified rows, most important first) and "## Duplicated logic in the framework adapters" (table | Locations | What is duplicated | Proposal | Owner |). Verified findings only.
